channel.title: Lodge
channel.description: Updates for Lodge, the SD card offloader for macOS.

item.description:
## Lodge 1.0
*Home base for your media.* Lodge offloads camera SD cards (video, photos, audio and sidecar files), verifies every copy and names everything the way you want.
- **Notices cards as you insert them.** Any removable drive with media on it, including cards that were already in when Lodge opened. - **A Card → Media → Destination window**, read left to right, with the offload bar along the bottom. - **Copies only what's new.** A ledger remembers every offloaded file, so inserting the same card again copies only new files. - **Verified copies.** Each file is read back from disk and checked with SHA-256 before it gets its final name. Nothing is ever overwritten. - **Naming templates** with tokens (`{project}`, `{camera}`, `{date}`, `{time}`, `{type}`, `{card}`, `{original}`, `{seq}`, `{ext}` and more), template presets and a live preview of every final name. - **Sidecars and proxies sorted.** Sidecars keep their clip's name; proxies go into `Proxies/` and sidecars into `Sidecars/`. - **Presets.** Save a whole setup and switch to it from the toolbar. - **Quick dump.** Skip the project name and offload a card right away. - **Skip short videos.** Accidental takes under a few seconds stay on the card. - **Favorite destinations** with their free space, one click apart. - **Re-offload** missing copies or the whole card, without overwriting. - **Format a card safely.** A **Ready to format** badge appears once every file has a verified copy. - **Thumbnails, list view and Quick Look.** - **Recent Offloads** with **Show in Finder**, which opens one window on the folder the copies share. - **Themes and Light mode.** - **Menu bar mode.** Keep Lodge in the menu bar to watch for cards. - **First-launch setup** that walks you through your first preset. - **A folder for each file type** inside the last folder. - **Choose which days to offload:** Any date, Today, Last 7 days or a custom range. - **Correct free space on external drives** that aren't APFS, and a clear message when a destination drive is read-only. - **Help ▸ Report a Bug…** with Lodge's log attached, and a crash-report prompt on the next launch. - **Check for Updates** (automatic checks can be turned off in Settings). - **Support Lodge** on Ko-fi.
Requires macOS 14 Sonoma or later. Universal: runs natively on Apple silicon and Intel Macs.
